change.title: Establish the R1 typed runtime failure envelope
change.summary: Introduces a crate-internal RuntimeError envelope with typed domain, phase, recovery disposition, environment exposure, and sanitized cause-chain fields. The existing one-click failure remains a compatible specialization, and frontend DTO keys, stage strings, recovery strings, environment strings, and human-readable messages remain unchanged. Transitional message-based recovery parsing is intentionally retained for later R1 slices.
